name: Hosmer Point Camp
description_short: Overnight camp in Craftsbury Common, Vermont, offering four 13-day sleepaway sessions for campers in grades 3-9. Tuition uses an honor-system sliding scale.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Scholarship text refers to 2026 ('Camp scholarship funds are available for 2026'), not 2027, so it may be out of date.
Early registration: 2026 campers could pre-register on Closing Day; siblings, returning and wait-listed campers from October 1, 2026; general public from November 2, 2026.
Contact email domain (hosmerpointcamp.org) differs from the website domain (hosmerpoint.com).
Ages 9-15 apply only to homeschoolers or campers from outside the US; other campers qualify by grade (3rd-9th).
Girl's Ride+Run Camp is a separate 4-day program with no exact dates given.
